name: Kidocare Child Care
description: A cheerful, high-trust nursery and early years childcare template featuring rounded typography, organic card masks, age-grouped programs, daily routine schedules, teacher spotlights, parent reviews, interactive FAQ, and tour booking CTA.
features: Editable logo, navigation links, hero storytime image, and headline stickers
Interactive 'Built on Trust' values with organic mask illustrations
Age-specific curriculum programs with tag filters and smooth carousel/grid
Daily routine schedule timeline from morning welcome to family pick-up
Educator team profiles with organic backdrop shapes and qualifications
Interactive parent testimonials and real-time review ratings
Accordion FAQ and vibrant tour booking banner with playful child cutout
Scoped CSS with original theme tokens and zero global style leakage
